operation.name: InsertNonGBVAttachmentDedicated_ELRP
operation.query: SET @ReturnValue = 0; INSERT INTO [NonGBVAttachmentDedicated_ELRP] ([NonGBVID] ,[Filename] ,[FileAttached] ,[ContentType] ,[CreationUserID] ,[LastModificationTimestamp] ,[LastModificationUserID] ,[Deleted]) VALUES (@NonGBVID ,@Filename ,@FileAttached ,@ContentType ,@CreationUserID ,@LastModificationTimestamp ,@LastModificationUserID ,0); SET @ReturnValue = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

operation.name: DeleteNonGBVAttachmentDedicated_ELRP
operation.query: IF(NOT EXISTS (SELECT NonGBVAttachmentID FROM NonGBVAttachmentDedicated_ELRP WHERE DELETED = 0 AND NonGBVAttachmentID = @NonGBVAttachmentID)) SET @ReturnValue = 0; ELSE BEGIN UPDATE [NonGBVAttachmentDedicated_ELRP] SET [LastModificationTimestamp] = GETDATE() ,[LastModificationUserID] = @UserID ,[Deleted] = 1 WHERE NonGBVAttachmentID = @NonGBVAttachmentID SET @ReturnValue = 1; END
